question: Ribosomes have three binding sites for the transfer RNAs (RNAs), which are:

options.opa: Site A of acetyl, P of propyl and E of ethyl.
options.opb: A site of aminoacyl, P of peptidyl and E of exit (from English, exit).
options.opc: A site of aminoacyl, peptidyl P and transferase T of the peptide.
options.opd: Site A of previous, P of posterior and E of entry (of English, entry).
options.ope: A site of aminoacyl, peptidyl P and terminating T.
